project.name: Make Sense Of A Spreadsheet
project.goal: There is a CSV of support tickets in this project's workspace at data/support-tickets.csv. Tell me what is actually happening in it and what I should do about it. Clean it first and say what you had to clean — it has two date formats, inconsistent product names, blank response times and at least one duplicate row, and every one of those changes an answer if it is ignored. Then find the things I would not spot myself: which product is getting worse rather than merely being large, whether anything changed on a particular date, where response time and satisfaction actually diverge, and which plan tier is carrying the pain. Do every count and average in code and ship the script, so I can re-run it next month and check you. State the sample size behind each claim, and say plainly when the data cannot answer something — 420 rows will not support a confident answer about everything, and pretending otherwise is the failure mode here.
